snippet.title: Silly Polly Beast ► Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Embrace your inner demon or be consumed by it. An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. SILLY POLLY BEAST is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom? Launching October 28th on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1598780/Silly_Polly_Beast/
